_comment: Components intentionally without a co-located *.stories.ts. Every entry needs a reason (no silent exclusion). The story-coverage gate exempts exactly these; everything else renderable must have a story. Keep paths relative to app-mobile/src.

allow.reason: Full-screen viewer host — driven entirely by ArtifactViewer context; exercised via the artifact cards' stories.
Context provider — renders no visual of its own; used AS a decorator in other stories.

Requires a live PDFDocumentProxy, which only a CSF loader can supply; Storybook's story arg typing cannot express a loader-injected required prop without a cast or suppression, both of which the codebase bans. Its rendering is exercised through PdfPreview's story, which loads the document itself.
Context provider — no isolated visual; supplies attachment-draft context to consuming surfaces.

Story-support scaffolding, not an app surface — it seeds the attachment draft with real Files so the context-only rail and preview dialog render populated states. Renders only its children, so it has no visual of its own.

Story-support scaffolding, not an app surface — it wraps SessionStateIcon in the same .state--idle / .state--running / .state--interrupted parent the roster supplies so currentColor resolves. Renders only its children, so it has no visual of its own.

Compositional Bits Menu content — renders Menu.Content/Sub internals that require a Menu.Root ancestor; throws "Context Menu.Root not found" when rendered standalone. Exercised via the plan-mode menu surface (PlanModeButton), same class as the shared Menu sub-parts.
SvelteKit route wrapper — the app shell, rendered in-situ only; not an isolated surface.
SvelteKit route wrapper (home route) — delegates to the Home page component, which is storied.
SvelteKit route wrapper — deep-link entry, no isolated visual.
SvelteKit route wrapper — mounts the Chat page, which is storied.
SvelteKit route wrapper — selects the hub's default segment; the hub itself is storied.
SvelteKit route wrapper — deep-link segment entry, no isolated visual of its own.
Route composition shell — resolves a segment and mounts the storied hub; renders nothing itself.
Compositional sub-part of RadioGroup — no standalone render.
Compositional Bits primitive — needs RadioGroupItem children; exercised via the effort picker surface.
Compositional sub-part of ToggleGroup — no standalone render.
Compositional Bits primitive — needs ToggleGroupItem children; exercised via the theme/runtime toggles.

Compositional Bits primitive — renders nothing without MenuTrigger/MenuContent/MenuItem children; exercised via consuming surfaces (Header, Plan menus).
